definition: On a right cone, the slant height $l$ is the distance from the vertex to the edge of the base, measured along the sloping surface; $l = \sqrt{r^{2} + h^{2}}$, so it is longer than the vertical height $h$.

term: angle between a line and a plane
definition: For a line that meets a plane, the angle between the line and its projection on the plane, the line joining the meeting point to the foot of a perpendicular dropped from a point on the line to the plane; it is never more than $90^{\circ}$.
